source_audits.source_name: Planning permissions on the London Development Database (LDD)
source_audits.publisher: Greater London Authority (GLA); data supplied by London planning authorities
source_audits.attribution_requirements: Attribute Greater London Authority, London Development Database, and relevant borough/planning authority; preserve OGL v3 notice.

coverage_years.planning_permissions_page: completed since 2006-04-01 and permissions since 2006-04-01, with starts/completions updated to 2019-03-31

source_audits.update_frequency: One off / archived; LDD replaced by Planning London Datahub and no longer updated on the Datastore page.
source_audits.geographic_scope: Greater London; smallest geography listed as Point Location.
source_audits.granularity: Planning permission / scheme row, plus related non-residential floorspace and bedroom scheme rows where matching authority/reference exists.
key_fields_used: Date work commenced on site (Started Date)
Date permission expires if work not commenced (Lapsed Date)
required_caveats: The LDD recorded significant planning permissions and development progress; it is not a direct opening, occupation, usage, or outcome source.
Completion date is source-supplied and has no single formal definition; do not overstate it as public opening or full occupation.
Planning permission, work-start, and construction-completion dates must remain separate event types.
Coordinates are point locations from LDD Easting/Northing fields; they are not footprints or precise entrance locations.
Figures relate to permission gains/losses and can differ from descriptions, especially phased schemes or split permissions.
Local planning authority records should be checked before promoting any candidate to canonical event status.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use selected rows as candidate development-completion records with visible provenance, source row references, coordinates caveats, and no claim of opening/occupation/outcomes.

filters: BNG Easting/Northing present and within a broad Greater London range
Institutional/public keyword or large development threshold: >=500 proposed homes, >=50,000 sqm proposed floorspace, >=300 proposed bedrooms, or >=8 ha site area
Deduplicate by planning authority and display title; cap at 60 rows
known_gaps: No per-row web URL was available for LDD archive spreadsheets; candidates use public dataset/download URLs plus workbook, sheet, Excel row, planning authority, and borough reference.
The housing completions unit-level file was downloaded and audited for source context, but this pack uses scheme-level permission rows to avoid turning unit rows into duplicate events.
Selection is a high-signal candidate pack, not a complete LDD completion export.
